MLBB hero builds 2026: what players build in ranked

Items, emblems and battle spells for Hanabi, Obsidia and eight other popular ranked heroes.

Hero builds

In this story

  1. Hero builds
  2. Most common items
  3. Emblems
  4. Battle spells
All news
In this story
Hero buildsMost common itemsEmblemsBattle spells

In brief

  • The most common core item is Dominance Ice: it is in the popular build of 24 heroes out of 133.
  • The most picked emblem is the Assassin emblem, used by 29 heroes. The Common emblem is chosen for only 6.
  • Flicker is the main spell for 62 heroes out of 133, Retribution for 20.

Each hero is shown with the most picked setup in their main lane. The three items form the core of the build. Win rate counts matches played with that setup.

Most common items

The most common core items
ItemHeroes with it in the build
Dominance Ice24 of 133
War Axe23 of 133
Sky Piercer23 of 133
Glowing Wand21 of 133
Corrosion Scythe15 of 133
Lightning Truncheon15 of 133
Hunter Strike15 of 133
Queen's Wings14 of 133

There is no single item everyone must buy: even the most common one is in the build of only every sixth hero. Defensive items such as Dominance Ice are taken by both tanks and fighters, which puts them at the top.

Emblems are chosen by the hero’s job, not only by role. That is why the Assassin emblem shows up on mages and the Fighter emblem on some marksmen: the Academy shows these heroes win more often with them.

Battle spells

Flicker stays the all-round choice for almost half the heroes: it saves you from death and helps start a fight. Junglers take Retribution, without which you cannot clear jungle monsters quickly.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I see the build for a specific MLBB hero?

On the hero page in our tier list: the most popular ranked build, the emblem with three talents, the battle spell and two alternatives. The data refreshes every few days.

Which emblem is picked most in MLBB?

The Assassin emblem — 29 heroes out of 133. The Mage and Fighter emblems come next.

Which battle spell is best in Mobile Legends?

Flicker most often: it is the main spell for 62 heroes out of 133. Junglers take Retribution.
